description: This file defines an abstract base class 'ArgumentDefaultPluginBase' for Drupal Views argument default plugins, including methods for handling arguments, options, access control, and cache tags.

classes.name: ArgumentDefaultPluginBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for argument default plugins in Drupal Views, providing common functionality and interface for subclasses.

methods.name: getArgument
methods.description: Returns the default argument; meant to be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: setArgument
methods.description: Sets the parent argument plugin instance.

methods.name: defineOptions
methods.description: Retrieves options for the plugin, defaulting to an empty array.

methods.name: buildOptionsForm
methods.description: Builds the options form for the plugin.

methods.name: submitOptionsForm
methods.description: Handles submission of the options form.

methods.name: access
methods.description: Checks if the current user has privileges to use this plugin.

methods.name: checkAccess
methods.description: Disables form options if the user lacks access.

methods.name: getCacheTags
methods.description: Returns cache tags associated with this plugin.
